# env

Print or modify the environment for a child command through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/env

moonx cli/env DEMO=value printenv DEMO

moonx cli/env -u DEMO printenv DEMO
```

Without a command, print the resulting environment. Otherwise apply assignments/removals and launch the command.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-i`, `--ignore-environment` | Start with an empty environment; bare - is equivalent. |
| `-u VALUE`, `--unset VALUE` | Remove a variable. |
| `-0`, `--null` | Separate printed entries with NUL. |
| `-C VALUE`, `--chdir VALUE` | Set the child working directory. |
| `-S VALUE`, `--split-string VALUE` | Split quotes, escapes and original-environment substitutions. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- -S splits its argument using the supported quoting and expansion rules; it does not invoke a host shell. Child execution requires launcher permission.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
